hero.headline: Team1 Africa — Regional Strength, Continental Reach
hero.subhead: Uniting Nigeria, Ghana, South Africa, Tanzania, Kenya, and Uganda to build Africa's Web3 future on Avalanche.

intro.title: About Team1 Africa
intro.content: Team1 Africa represents the collective power of six regional teams working together to advance blockchain adoption across the continent. We combine local expertise with continental vision, creating opportunities for developers, entrepreneurs, and communities to thrive in the Avalanche ecosystem.

collaboration.title: How We Work Together
methods: Shared playbooks and best practices across all regional teams
Monthly cross-regional syncs to align strategy and share learnings
Collaborative projects that leverage strengths from multiple regions

regionalLeadRole.title: Regional Lead Responsibilities
regionalLeadRole.description: Regional Leads serve as the primary connection between their local ecosystems and the global Team1 network. They are responsible for executing regional strategy, building local communities, and representing their region's voice in continental planning.
keyResponsibilities: Execute localized go-to-market strategies aligned with continental goals
Build, manage, and grow regional contributor teams
Track and report key performance indicators (events, developers, projects)
Maintain strong relationships with local ecosystem partners
deliverables: Monthly community events and developer workshops
Regular content creation (blogs, videos, social media)
Monthly progress reports and performance metrics
